name: TeamStarWolf - Change Healthcare Attack 2024
description: Techniques in the Change Healthcare ransomware attack of February 2024, not an official MITRE mapping. Sources: Andrew Witty's House and Senate testimony and UHG's answers for the record, the State of Nebraska complaint, FBI, CISA and HHS advisory AA23-353A, and ATT&CK software S1068 BlackCat as published in ATT&CK v20. Tactics are taken from data/attack/technique_profiles.jsonl. Scores: 100 is documented in the Change record, 75 is alleged in the Nebraska complaint, 40 is ALPHV/BlackCat general tradecraft not documented at Change. Each comment names source numbers from the Sources table of case-studies/CHANGE_HEALTHCARE_2024.md.
